topics.title: Coalition of nonprofits sues frontier AI labs to halt model development over catastrophic risks
topics.summary: A coalition of nonprofits, including Public Citizen and The Alliance for Secure AI, filed a lawsuit on November 12, 2026, in San Francisco Superior Court against Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceXSI. Invoking California public nuisance laws, the suit seeks an injunction freezing advanced frontier AI development due to uncontrollable catastrophic risks.

topics.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for rapid execution and agentic developer workflows
topics.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen on November 12, 2026, as a high-speed execution model featuring a 1-million-token context window. Priced at $1.50 per million input and $7.50 per million output tokens, the model targets everyday software development, agentic orchestration in Antigravity, and powers upgraded query understanding in Google Search.

topics.title: Cloudflare open-sources Kitesurf browser engine for AI agents on Cloudflare Workers
topics.summary: Cloudflare announced on November 13, 2026, that it has open-sourced Kitesurf, its lightweight browser engine designed for AI agents running on Cloudflare Workers. Released under Apache 2.0, Kitesurf parses HTML and CSS via Rust WebAssembly packages and supports Chrome DevTools Protocol without headless Chromium containers.
